entries.zh: 没有尽头；没完没了，无休无止
entries.en: to have no end; endless, interminable

entries.zh: 身体不适；健康不佳（引申为心神不安）
entries.en: to be in poor health; to be unwell; to be uneasy

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏 'q̃' 当展开为 que，'llegar abaxo' 句义不通，H 有 [疑]、M 有 T99，四栏不足定夺（疑指无物下咽）。

entries.zh: 临丧不哀；没有悲伤之情，对丧事无动于衷
entries.en: to feel no sorrow or grief (at a funeral); to be unmoved
entries.notes: M 栏 ṣōng 带 T99（声调符号污损），依规则记 low；L 与 H「臨喪不哀」互证，语义本身明确。

entries.zh: 不合；不相合、不投契
entries.en: to have no obligation and no agreement; to be at variance
entries.notes: M 栏夹写 'ni cam formīdad'，知 L 全句为 'no tener obligación ni conformidad'；H「不合」只对应后一半。

entries.zh: 没有空闲；无暇（引申为没有机会）
entries.en: to have no leisure or opportunity; to be fully occupied
entries.notes: L 末 'citaruyado' 无法解读，H 有 [疑]（榮/泣），M 'bô-êng' 指向「無閒」，与 'lugar'（闲暇、机会）相合。

entries.zh: 没有活儿可做；赋闲（有空闲）
entries.en: to have nothing to work at; to be at leisure, out of work
entries.notes: H 有 [疑:閒/閑]（异体），且 M 'eñg cañg' 无否定词，与 L 'no tener' 不相合；H「閒工」义为空闲。

entries.zh: 没有活儿干；无工可做
entries.en: to have no work to do; to have nothing to work at

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔Original damaged; gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: L 栏 'los nayo' 无法解读，H「鼻不出」与 M 相合但语义不明，四栏不足以定夺。

entries.zh: 没有勇气；没有精神、没有气力
entries.en: to have no courage or spirit; to lack mettle

entries.zh: 绝灭；断子绝孙，香火断绝
entries.en: to have no descendants; to be extinct, the line cut off

entries.zh: 绝后代；没有子孙
entries.en: to leave no descendants; to have no offspring

entries.zh: 不好；不善（没有好处）
entries.en: they are not good; there is no good in them
entries.notes: L 句尾 '~' 后无下文，H「無向好」为闽南语式直译，义为不善、不好。

entries.zh: 不必为此费力；不必为此劳神
entries.en: one need not exert oneself over that; don't tire yourself about it

entries.zh: 不必为此费心；不必白费心气
entries.en: no need to waste one's spirit or effort over that
entries.notes: H 末字有 [疑:橈/撓]，M 'quy' 与第 10 条「無氣」同，疑当作「心氣」，义为不必白费心气。

entries.zh: 没有尽头；永无了结（没完没了）
entries.en: to have no end; endless, interminable

entries.zh: 不合理；没有道理
entries.en: to be unreasonable; to have no reason

entries.zh: 不合；不一致、不相投
entries.en: to have no conformity; to be at variance

entries.zh: 没有道理；无理
entries.en: to have no reason; to be in the wrong; unreasonable

entries.zh: 一文不值；不值钱
entries.en: to be worth nothing; worthless

entries.zh: 隔绝；不再相见，断绝往来
entries.en: to be cut off; to see each other no more

entries.zh: 断绝往来；互不探访
entries.en: to cease visiting one another; to be completely cut off
entries.notes: L 末 'el foltia' 无法解读，H/M「絕斷不來」义为断绝往来。
